## CMV RETINITIS AND ACUTE RETINAL NECROSIS
Infection in immunocompetent patients is rare and usually associated with
minimal or no symptoms. Patients in whom the risk for CMV disease is increased
include solid organ and bone marrow transplant recipients, persons receiving
prolonged immunosuppressive chemotherapy, and persons with advanced HIV disease
indicated by a CD4 count of less than 50 cells/microliter. Treatment is complex
and requires Infectious Diseases consultation.
For sight threatening lesions (lesions within 1500 microns of the fovea)
intravitreal infections of ganciclovir or foscarnet are recommended in addition
to systemic treatment. Contact Infectious Diseases for more information.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Treat retinitis for 14 to 21 days. Patients may be converted to oral therapy
after initial intravenous therapy and after clinical improvement of severe
disease. Treat acute retinal necrosis with IV therapy for at least 7 days and
until disease stabilizes then oral therapy for a minimum of 6 weeks. Maintenance
therapy after completion of treatment is indicated when CD4 count <100.
Discontinue maintenance therapy when CD4 count is >100 for 6 months.
## Treatment acute retinal necrosis or severe disease
Intravitreal antiviral in addition to systemic antiviral may provide added
therapeutic efficacy.
## Inpatient

[Ganciclovir 5 mg/kg IV q12h ($$$$) [R,O]](psjizid-ganciclovir-5-mg-kg-iv-q12h)
< OR >
[Foscarnet 90 mg/kg IV q12h ($$$$) [R,O]](psjizid-foscarnet-0-09-gm-kg-iv-q12h)
Optional add-on therapy for acute retinal necrosis
[Ganciclovir 4mg/0.1mL intravitreal injection STAT ($$$$) [R,O]](psjzid-ganciclovir-2mg-intravitreous-inject-once)
< OR >
[Foscarnet 2.4mg/0.1 mL intravitreal injection STAT ($$$$) [R,O]](psjzid-foscarnet-2-4mg-intravitreous-inject-once)
## For cases not responsive to Intravenous therapy with foscarnet and ganciclovir
## used alone
[Ganciclovir 5 mg/kg IV q12h ($$$$) [R,O] <AND> foscarnet 90 mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-ganciclovir-5mg-kg-iv-q12h-foscar-90mg-kg-iv-q12h)
($$$$) [R,O]
In cases not responsive to first-line therapy, second-line therapies may be
effective. Their use is highly specialized and must be done by someone
experienced with HIV/AIDS medicine.
## Treatment of mild to moderate retinitis or after clinical improvement of severe
## retinitis/acute retinal necrosis
[Valganciclovir 900 mg PO q12h($$$) [R,O]](psjzid-valganciclovir-900mg-po-q12h)
## Maintenance therapy
[Valganciclovir 900 mg PO q24h ($$$) [R,O]](psjzid-valganciclovir-900-mg-po-q24h)
